readerCopy.body: A postponed decision can become much more concrete once it arrives with a deadline, responsibility, or consequence. When Saturn conjoins the North Node, structure and forward movement meet, bringing paperwork, titles, schedules, contracts, or people depending on an answer into the choice. Pressure is not proof that the answer should be yes. It does provide terms that can be measured, making the next direction less theoretical than it was before.
